_readme.about: The permanent project registry: curated projects plus projects detected from headlines. Never trimmed: a record is hidden, never deleted. Status, history, events, figures and confidence are rebuilt every run by replaying the record's headlines in date order. Corrections go in data/project_overrides.json.

fields.count: Number of records, hidden ones included.
fields.records: The records, curated first. Each record: see 'registry record fields'.

record_fields.id: Permanent id: operator-place-state-year for detected records ('aws-richmond-county-nc-2026'), operator-state-unnamed for umbrellas, the projects.json id for curated ones.
record_fields.name: Display name.
record_fields.companies: Operators (fetch_news.COMPANIES names). A detected record with none takes them from a later headline.
record_fields.lat: Latitude of the place (town, county centroid or state centre).
record_fields.precision: city, county, state or source: how exactly the place is known.
record_fields.curated: true for a project from data/projects.json.
record_fields.verified: Curated only: checked against an official source.
record_fields.notes: Curated only: notes shown on the project.
record_fields.timeline: Curated only: milestones {date, event, url} from projects.json.
record_fields.announced: Curated only: YYYY-MM it was announced.
record_fields.curated_status: Curated only: the status in projects.json, which always wins.
record_fields.imported: Curated only: the day the registry first saw it.
record_fields.news: Every headline attached to the record: {id, title, link, source, published, stage_signal, cluster_id}. stage_signal is re-read from the title with today's rules every run.
record_fields.first_seen: Publication time of the earliest attached headline.
record_fields.last_news: Publication time of the latest attached headline.
record_fields.status: Announced, Under construction, Operational or Cancelled / Blocked (Planned is curated only).
record_fields.status_history: Each status change: {date, status, headline_id, by}; by is 'curated' or 'override' when not from a headline.
record_fields.events: Timeline events that do not change the status: {date, type, headline_id}; type is Approval, Power deal, Expansion, Cancelled or Revived.
record_fields.capacity_mw: Largest capacity in the record's headlines (or the curated value).
record_fields.investment_usd_b: Largest investment in the record's headlines (or the curated value), billions of dollars.
record_fields.sources_count: Distinct outlets among the attached headlines.
record_fields.confidence: high (operator, town or county, 2+ outlets), medium (operator or figure, and a town or county) or low.
record_fields.hidden: true when the record is not shown (merged, hidden by an override).
record_fields.merged_into: When merged: the id of the record that now holds its headlines.
record_fields.hidden_by_override: true when a 'hide' override hid it.
record_fields.umbrella: true for 'Operator, State (site not yet named)': headlines that name only the state.
record_fields.aliases: Extra names that match the record (from 'alias' overrides).
record_fields.renamed: true when a 'rename' override set the name.
record_fields.utilities: Utilities named in the record's headlines.
record_fields.investors: Investors named in the record's headlines.
record_fields.builders: Builders named in the record's headlines.
record_fields.suppliers: Suppliers named in the record's headlines.
record_fields.name_hints: Project names seen in the record's headlines; a headline with the same name in the same state matches.
record_fields.location_events: Place corrections: {date, type 'Moved to <place>', headline_id, from} when re-tagged headlines name a better place (shown on the timeline).
record_fields.location_locked: true when a set_location override placed the record; it is never moved automatically.
record_fields.hidden_reason: Why the registry hid a record itself: 'not a project: ...' when none of its headlines may start a project (a question, a body weighing a restriction, something other than a data center).
